name: Grade 8 IT: Web Portfolio and Search
description: HTML, CSS, images, alt text, links, search keywords, operators, credits, Google Sites portfolios, navigation, videos, and calls to action.

words.definition: Markup used to structure web page content.
words.example: HTML created headings, paragraphs, lists, and links.

words.definition: A markup instruction surrounded by angle brackets.
words.example: The h1 tag created a heading.

words.definition: Text that names a page or section.
words.example: The heading introduced the campaign topic.

words.definition: A block of text about one idea.
words.example: The paragraph explained the campaign purpose.

words.definition: Clickable text or media that opens another page or place.
words.example: The link opened the research source.

words.definition: A language used to style web pages.
The part of a CSS rule that chooses what to style.
A CSS feature being changed, such as color or font size.
words.example: The color property made text blue.

words.definition: A text description of an image.
words.example: Alt text helped explain the campaign image.

words.definition: An important search word or phrase.
A search or logic word that changes results.
words.example: AND and NOT helped refine the search.

words.definition: A collection of project evidence and reflections.
words.example: The Google Sites portfolio showed graphics and research.

words.definition: The way users move through a website.
words.example: Clear navigation connected all site pages.

words.definition: A note that names a creator or source.
Text that explains an image or video.
words.example: The caption described the vector graphic.

words.definition: A plan that shows scenes or shots for a video.
words.example: The environmental video used a five-shot storyboard.

words.definition: A message that asks the audience to do something.
words.example: The homepage had a call to action about saving water.

words.definition: A written or spoken review of learning and design choices.
words.example: The reflection explained one challenge solved.
